title: Para Bellum content: companies
description: The commitment unit (AD-M46): a division is made of companies, and a battle's force is chosen in companies. File: Content/<namespace>/company.json. Platoons are written inline and support sections use the same shape, so one walk covers both. A company stores neither men nor officers: both are derived by walking to its squads and vehicle crew. The contract is docs/design/CONTENT_MODEL.md in the game repository.

platoon.description: One platoon, written inline in its company: a player's company is ONE document, and nothing else ever refers to a platoon. So a platoon has a name and no id, and this is where the company stops holding things by reference.

name.description: What this platoon is called in this company, for example No 1 or Scout.

count.description: How many. Required in a file (the reader has no defaults, C101); a designer offers 1 for a new slot. It belongs to this slot, never to the thing named, so one design serves several parents at different counts.

element.description: One squad type or one vehicle design, and how many. Exactly one of squad and vehicle. This is the floor: nothing goes below it.

vehicle.description: A design (a model or a variant), by id. Its model must author crew, where 0 is a real answer (C308). This records what is in the platoon, not what it costs: nothing here draws from the stockpile (AD-M47).

count.description: How many. Required in a file (the reader has no defaults, C101); a designer offers 1 for a new slot. It belongs to this slot, never to the thing named, so one design serves several parents at different counts.

name.description: What the player reads. Optional for a mod, required of shipped content (C802).

category.description: What kind of force this is, by id: diminishing returns and support requirements key on it.

support_sections.description: The company's own HQ, mortar, anti-tank, spotter and scout sections. They commit with the company and are not separately priced. May be empty.

stats.description: One value per AUTHORED division stat in Content/vocabulary.json, all of them (C411). A walked or table stat cannot be set here (C415).

terrain.description: Combat effectiveness per biome, per mille, where 1000 is the baseline. An absent biome is the baseline, so plain infantry's table is empty. May be empty.
